source.check: returned unopposed: 'The other 24 outgoing members have all been re-nominated. They include the Chairman, Mr. Robert A. Brown, O.B.E., J.P., and the vice-chairman, Mr. T. J. Bradley, J.P.' (Mid-Ulster Mail 20 May 1967 p1, image read); Swatragh was the only contest.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Swatragh was the only contest among the 26 seats; the other divisions were filled unopposed and their names were not printed in the reports used here. The twenty-five unopposed members added from the nominations report (Mid-Ulster Mail, 20 May 1967, p. 1), which names 23 of them with their divisions; Ringsend and Magherafelt (the chairman and vice-chairman, re-nominated) are inferred from the 1964 return (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). division inferred from the 4 June 1964 return (Robt. A. Brown, Ringsend; Mid-Ulster Mail, 23 May 1964, p. 1); the Mid-Ulster Mail of 20 May 1967, p. 1, names the member as an outgoing member re-nominated without opposition. Returned unopposed.
